behaviour: C1: joinGroupFromWelcomeCore resolves the Welcome's MLS group id PRE-JOIN: the pending entry's groupId when non-empty, else readWelcomeGroupInfo(...).groupContext.groupId via readPreJoinGroupData; never from the rumor's self-claimed pubkey. An unresolvable id ('') skips the checks below.

C2: id resolved and marmotClient.groups.has(id) and an overlay record exists -> already joined: no joinGroupFromWelcome, the existing Group is returned unchanged; callers remove the invitation / consume the outbound record and fire onGroupJoined.

C3: id resolved and groups.has(id) but no overlay record -> orphan (interrupted accept or leave residue): await marmotClient.groups.destroy(id) (local only, no raw store deletes, no publish), then the normal join + saveGroup.

C4: manual accept (acceptPendingInvitation) and auto-accept (subscribeToWelcomes) both go through the same core; the existing catch in acceptPendingInvitation (remove invitation + 'This invitation is no longer valid') stays as the last resort for any other failure, including a failing destroy.
C5: startup (MarmotContext init, after groups.loadAll()) drops pending invitations whose non-empty groupId has an overlay record; entries with an empty groupId are never touched.
C6: privacy invariant untouched: no new network publishes; destroy is local.
non_goals: Global startup purge of orphan MLS groups.
